name: llmslim
description: Long-term memory with no LLM in the loop: stores messages word for word in local SQLite and recalls the ones that answer a question within a token budget.

interface.shortDescription: Local long-term memory with no LLM in the loop
interface.longDescription: Runs the LLMSlim MCP server on your machine with uvx, pinned to one release. It stores messages word for word in a local SQLite file and returns the stored messages that answer a question, under their dates and whole where they fit, within a token budget. It can also shrink a long text to a token budget, keeping what answers a query. No LLM, no embedding API and no API key.
